items.raw_excerpt: If German is not your mother tongue, you might have spent some time in a German class in Austria, but can those expenses be deducted from your taxes?
items.summary_en: Many expats in Austria take German classes. You may be able to deduct the cost from your taxes. The rules depend on your job and why you are learning.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아에 사는 외국인 중 독일어를 배우는 사람이 많습니다. 학원비를 세금 공제받을 수 있는 경우가 있습니다. 직업과 학습 목적에 따라 규정이 다릅니다.
items.title_en: Can I deduct German language course costs from my Austrian taxes?
items.title_ko: 오스트리아에서 독일어 학원 비용을 세금 공제 받을 수 있나요
items.title_original: Can I deduct the cost of a German language course in my Austrian tax return?

items.raw_excerpt: Family alleges there was a lack of communication and collaboration about toddler’s care.
items.summary_en: A family in Nova Scotia says their toddler with autism was sent home from daycare because of his disability. The mother says the center did not talk with her or work together on how to care for her child.
items.summary_ko: 노바스코샤의 한 가족이 자폐가 있는 아이가 장애를 이유로 어린이집에서 퇴소당했다고 주장하고 있다. 엄마는 어린이집 측이 아이의 돌봄 방식에 대해 충분히 소통하거나 협력하지 않았다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Mother says daycare dismissed her child with autism
items.title_ko: 자폐 아이가 어린이집에서 퇴소당한 사연, 엄마가 직접 털어놔
items.title_original: Mother speaks out after child with autism dismissed from daycare

items.raw_excerpt: A shortage of tap water has led to rationing on Koh Samui, where a prolonged dry spell has reduced clean water production capacity to about 40% of normal levels, according to the Provincial Waterworks Authority (PWA).
items.summary_en: Tap water is now rationed on Koh Samui island. A long dry spell has cut clean water production to about 40% of normal levels. The water authority says supplies are critically low.
items.summary_ko: 코사무이 섬에서 수돗물 배급이 시작됐다. 장기 가뭄으로 깨끗한 물 생산량이 평소의 약 40%로 떨어졌다. 수도 당국은 공급이 심각하게 부족하다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Koh Samui starts water rationing due to drought

items.raw_excerpt: Have you ever wondered what’s up with those tiny bathrooms in old Copenhagen apartments? Keep reading to learn about the history behind them.
items.summary_en: Old Copenhagen apartments are known for their very small bathrooms. This article explains the history and reasons behind their compact size.
items.summary_ko: 오래된 코펜하겐 아파트는 화장실이 매우 작기로 유명합니다. 이 기사는 그 좁은 공간 뒤에 숨은 역사와 이유를 설명합니다.
items.title_en: Why Copenhagen apartments have tiny bathrooms
items.title_original: What's up with Copenhagen apartments' minuscule bathrooms?

items.raw_excerpt: Filme Minha Terra Estrangeira foi uma das atrações do Bonito CineSur, que ocorre até sábado (1°/8).
items.summary_en: A documentary about indigenous voices was shown at the Bonito CineSur film festival in Brazil. The director says indigenous people need visibility in culture and media, not just in politics. The festival continues until Saturday.
items.summary_ko: 원주민의 목소리를 담은 다큐멘터리가 브라질 보니투 영화제에서 상영됐다. 영화감독은 원주민이 정치뿐 아니라 문화와 미디어에서도 더 많이 보여야 한다고 말했다. 영화제는 토요일까지 이어진다.
items.title_en: Indigenous filmmaker says representation matters beyond elections
items.title_ko: 원주민 영화감독이 말하는 진정한 대표성의 의미
items.title_original: Representação indígena vai além de candidatos eleitos, diz cineasta

items.summary_en: Strong winds are expected in parts of East Iceland this afternoon. The Icelandic Met Office warns drivers of caravans and trailers to be careful, especially in the southern Eastfjords.
